title: Nexus Architecture
summary: Nexus Architecture is the core technical framework of SORA v3, encompassing accounts, transactions, execution, consensus, cryptography, and data availability primitives. It defines how the network processes state transitions, validates blocks, and maintains distributed consensus across all participants.
